title: Create: Danger Zone
description: Re-textures weathered iron blocks to look like black and yellow stripey hazard blocks.
body:
There are many dangers in a factory enviroment that may lead to injuries or worse. With this bright yellow and black stripey block you can now clearly mark the more dangerous part of your factory to help prevent accidents. Re-textures indstrual weathered iron blocks. Renames them as well but only supports English for now.

![DANGER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e2935865ffaf684ac9b11cf311e5e1431b4e1e6_0.webp)

_Average aftereffect of a drilling operation_

![SET](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d20e6dc486d1908735a0e9662d6104bde1816633_0.webp)

_The panes and the windows are retextured too_
